Well is your personalized daily health partner.

With Well, you’re treated like a name instead of a number. Well works to understand you, then suggests the next step fit for you — while rewarding you every step of the way. Get your first bonus just for signing up.

With Well, you are…

- WELL rewarded: Healthy is job one. So why not get paid to do it? Earn hundreds in rewards by taking simple, healthy steps. Celebrate the small wins, because they add up over time. And when you’re ready to cash in on your good work, choose gift cards from a wide variety of your favorite brands.

- WELL empowered: It’s easier to take that next step when you know the facts. Build confidence and momentum in your health journey with do-able tips that fit into your regular day and help move you towards your goals. With someone in your corner, you can get started on that new health routine.

You’ll be happy to know our Well Guide team does it live and on-demand. Does that sound like typical healthcare to you? 

What others are saying about Well:

- “It's not just about losing weight, getting exercise, or lowering blood pressure. It's about all of that. It’s about your overall health.” — Kim W.

- “Thank you so much for finding them (a urologist) for me! I’ll be able to stay within the group for all of my needs…Thank you again for your help!” — Pablo L.

- “I love the emphasis on mental health in the workplace, because for a very long time, all I did was work.” —  Hannah L.

- “Well is by far my favorite app on my phone.” — Mark D.

Learn more about us at well.co

title: CCP Patient Portal
description:
The Cardiology Consultants of Philadelphia, (CCP Patient Portal), app connects you, the patient, with your healthcare provider and helps you conveniently manage cardiovascular care for you and your family members.

With the CCP Patient Portal app, you can: 
• Connect with your cardiovascular provider
• View your cardiovascular Profile
• Receive alerts
• View and schedule appointments
• Request refills
• Communicate with office staff for billing and general inquiries
• Share data securely and in real time with cardiovascular provider
• Take care of your loved ones
• Integrate with Apple HealthKit to retrieve daily exercise logs, sleep patterns and health data

To use the CCP Patient Portal App, you will need an invitation or login from your provider. Please contact our office directly for assistance with login or require support for the app.

Please note if you have already enrolled in CCP’s previous Patient Portal, you will be able to log in to this portal app with your existing credentials.

Please seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.

title: Salvo Health
description:
Sign up for Salvo Health now, the only virtual clinic for those with IBS, GERD, SIBO, and other chronic gut conditions. We’re supported and staffed by board-certified leading gut specialists, health coaches, psychologists, clinicians, and dietitians. 

⚕️How does Salvo Health work?

Ever wish you could get the healthcare you need, without having to make an appointment? At an affordable cost?

Salvo Health has designed a virtual clinic app that delivers continuous care, like an async chat feature, automated reminders, and a custom interactive course of care that helps those living with chronic gut issues manage their symptoms.

When you become a Salvo Health Member, you work with a team of board-certified, expert health specialists who diagnose, coach and equip you with resources, tools, and strategies to better manage your chronic conditions daily. They provide science-backed treatments based on Salvo Health’s compassionate model of care, Whole Self Science. Whole Self Science deeply focuses on understanding the whole person in order to uncover and treat root causes to get their body back in balance.

No more panic, no more stress, no more missing social activities, no matter what you and your gut face.  

📱 What’s included in the Salvo Health app?

✅ Appointment set-up for diagnostics and testing near you 
✅ Access to prescriptions and supplements for better gut health
✅ A custom-to-you Course of Care to follow daily, including gut-friendly recipes, brain-gut exercises, and new approaches to managing sleep and stress.  
✅ A specialized Care Team including your own gastrointestinal specialist, board-certified health coach, dedicated nurse practitioner, and Care Navigator who will guide you on your gut health journey 
✅ An async 24/7 chat, where you can message and hear from your own Care Team regularly.
✅ Daily guides, nudges, and reminders that will keep you on track to managing  your gut. 
✅ A hub of articles, quizzes, audio-blogs, and other helpful tools, created and curated by the country’s leading gut specialists 

Sign up to become a Salvo Health Member today, and put your body back into balance.

description:
Welcome to the Community Guidance Center's Telehealth app, your gateway to accessible and compassionate mental health support from the comfort of your own space. We understand the importance of mental well-being, and we're here to make it easier for you to connect with qualified mental health professionals whenever you need them. 

🌟 Secure and Convenient Telehealth Sessions  

Access confidential and safe video, voice, or chat sessions with our licensed therapists, counselors, and psychiatrists. Receive the support you deserve without leaving your home. 

🧠 Diverse and Expert Mental Health Providers  

Our providers are a diverse group of mental health experts, ensuring you can find the right fit for your unique needs. They specialize in multiple areas, including anxiety, depression, trauma, and relationship issues. 

🧡 Supportive Community  

Learn about our consumer Group sessions and connect with others on a similar journey. Share experiences, gain insights, and encourage one another. 

🔒 Confidential and HIPAA-Compliant  

Rest assured, your data and conversations are protected with the highest level of security and adhere to strict HIPAA guidelines. 

💼 Dedicated Case Management For those seeking long-term support, our case management feature ensures you receive personalized care and support throughout your mental health journey. 

🌐 Accessible from Anywhere  

Our app is available on multiple devices, making easy connections with your mental health provider, even while you are on the go. 

We believe you deserve access to quality mental health care, and our Mental Health Telehealth app design breaks down barriers to mental health care. Take the first step towards better mental health and well-being. Download our app today. 

Remember, you are not alone on this journey, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Your mental health matters, and with our app, you can prioritize it like never before. 

Download now to start your journey towards a healthier, happier you. Together, we can make a difference in your mental well-being.
